observation.int: natural bounded nonnegative int modulo scalar result
observation.number: exact quarter rational sum; current ieee-f64-bits-v1
observation.owned: complete existing tree tokens; full UTF8/NUL scalar contents, empty rows, Row3/Node3 fields; external formatting only
observation.nativeABI: PENDING actual release emission: exact reviewed source/counterpart and emitted hashes, function0 data args/natural result, standard owners and actual nominal fields/recursive identity. Internal callable graphs are compiler semantics, not extra external adapter ABI requirements.

costs: Whole iterations include function-value bindings, callbacks/factory setup and invocation(s), independent native clone where source asks for it, accumulation and full owned result retention.

Native clone copies owned buffers recursively; TS clone helper returns identity. No row mutates an aliased clone except mutate-array, whose returned result is a snapshot before a separate caller copy and no later mutation.

Native string byte-length quirks do not affect any timed result; replacement uses ASCII x matches and the same four ordinary substitution tokens, original prefix/suffix at every match, preserves astral/NUL and combining content.
Descriptors/methods may inline or erase; no claim of equal heap allocations or dispatch strategy.
int/number scalar results observe all returned values through ordered accumulation; per-invocation accuracy/effects are separately tested, not proved by final checksum alone.
TypeScript has no owned/once/read/mutate annotations; counterpart removes these annotations and runs the same natural function values and effects.
